subject: Trial sprintcard: success metrics, ops checklist and kickoff next steps
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta@brightwave.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@brightwave.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial sprintcard: success metrics, ops checklist and kickoff next steps

Hi Marta / Tom – thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed plan so we can lock timelines and owners for the trial.

Recap (what we heard)
- Goal: Validate Rouge-style accuracy + latency under production-like traffic for BrightWave's customer support summarization pipeline.
- Primary success signals: accuracy on the provided evaluation set, end-to-end latency, and qualitative readouts from your product team.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm)
- Metric A (accuracy): F1 / ROUGE-L on the evaluation set >= 0.78 (we'll compute against the sample prompts you shared).
- Metric B (latency): 95th percentile end-to-end generation latency < 300 ms at baseline load (50 qps).
- Metric C (quality): 15 representative prompts reviewed by your product owners with < 2 critical regressions.

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff, by Oct 1): exchange final prompt set, access permissions, and signed SOW.
- Week 1 (Oct 4–Oct 8): provisioning + smoke tests + run evaluation set.
- Week 2 (Oct 11–Oct 15): stress runs, optimization pass (batching/quantization), and final readout.

Owners (proposed)
- Redwood tech lead: Dylan Brooks — infra, test harness, sample runs (cc'd).
- Redwood engagement lead: Priya Natarajan — POC playbook, deliverables, exec syncs.
- BrightWave product lead: Marta Lopez — evaluation prompts and qualitative sign-off.

Attachments: RW-POC-sprintcard.xlsx (detailed checklist), SOW-draft.pdf (SOW + payment/term stub). Also linking the sprintcard in Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3C-POC-sprintcard

Asks / next steps (please reply to confirm):
1) Confirm success criteria above (or suggest edits).
2) Confirm kickoff window: Oct 4 at 10:00 AM PT works?
3) Can BrightWave share the sample prompt set and the internal reviewer list by Oct 1?
4) We’ll send an editable SOW (attached). Can I get a short list of procurement steps needed to execute the SOW?

If that looks good I’ll schedule the kickoff and Dylan will begin provisioning (infra checklist attached).

Thanks — Priya

--
Priya Natarajan
Engagement Lead, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

From: Marta Lopez <marta@brightwave.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@brightwave.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial sprintcard: success metrics, ops checklist and kickoff next steps

Thanks Priya — great summary and aligned on most items. A few quick notes from BrightWave: 

- The success criteria look solid. Two requests: please add a sample prompt latency objective for the interactive demo (p95 < 200 ms) and include a small set of negative prompts to stress hallucination cases.
- We can share the 15 representative prompts and the full evaluation CSV by Oct 1. I’ll send them to you and cc Tom.
- Kickoff: Oct 4 at 10:00 AM PT works for our team. Please send a calendar invite with dial-in.

Open items on our side:
- Procurement: we have a standard PO process (legal needs the SOW + security questionnaire). Can you attach your security questionnaire so our InfoSec team can start the review?
- SOW: We’ve reviewed the draft; a couple of small redlines on IP/retention — I’ll flag those in DocuSign.

On the metric about latency at load: can Redwood confirm the environment you’ll provision is representative of production (we need cloud subnet access and token-scoped keys for test harness)?

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Head of Product, BrightWave
marta@brightwave.com

Thanks — I’m on it and I’ll be the technical lead for the POC. Quick ops notes and timeline from my side: 

- Provisioning plan: I’ll provision a dedicated test pool with the model variant we discussed and enable KV/cache settings matching your sequence lengths. Need the following from BrightWave by Oct 1:
  * Cloud subnet/VPC peering CIDR (for traffic shaping)
  * Service account/email to generate scoped API keys
  * Sample prompt set (we’ll use 50 prompts for smoke and the 15 for qualitative review)

- Infra tasks (I’ll own): infra-checklist.md attached — will complete baseline provisioning by Oct 2 and run smoke tests Oct 4 morning so we’re green for the kickoff.
- Measurement: I’ll instrument 95th/99th percentile latency and end-to-end tracing; will publish a dashboard link ahead of the Week 2 readout.

If BrightWave can share the subnet + service account by EOD Sep 30 I’ll hit the provisioning timeline.

-Dylan

If any of the owners need help I can step in to unblock (procurement intro, security sync, or calendar wrangling). I’ll schedule the kickoff for Oct 4 10:00 AM PT and share an agenda (30–45 min): 1) introductions 2) baseline smoke run 3) evaluation plan 4) open risks & next steps.
